Let I = ∫ 3*exp(x)*sin(x) dx.

Using the standard result:

∫ exp(x)*sin(x) dx = (1/2)*exp(x)*(sin(x) - cos(x)) + C

Therefore:

I = 3*(1/2)*exp(x)*(sin(x) - cos(x)) + C

So the antiderivative is:

<answer>(3/2)*exp(x)*(sin(x) - cos(x)) + C</answer>
